digest.component_or_area: Jira DC live-instance readiness and provisioning
propositions: The readiness gate polls /rest/api/2/serverInfo until 200 but does not verify that required custom fields (Epic Link, Epic Name) are registered, allowing premature ready declaration when a plugin has not yet initialized its fields.

A timing flake results: if the test harness executes faster or the plugin initializes slower, _assert_project_capabilities fails with a missing-field error that is misattributed to an image degrade instead of provisioning latency.

The probe workflow and harness workflow use two different readiness definitions (field-polling vs serverInfo-only), allowing them to drift; Gerrit 1387 fixed the probe alone without unifying the contract.

The readiness check must distinguish between 'fields not yet registered' (a transient state requiring wait) and 'instance does not offer these fields' (a genuine image degrade), but current messaging conflates them.

A system-only field inventory (no customfield_* entries) must be treated as NOT-READY, not as a succeeded readiness, so latent flakes surface deterministically rather than appearing only on fast runs.
